# DexBuilder Developer Docs

> APIs and integration guides for perpetual trading applications and Builders launching their own trading frontend.

## Start here

- Overview: /index
- Trader quickstart: /getting-started/trader-quickstart
- Builder overview: /builders/overview
- Builder onboarding: /builders/onboarding
- Builder quickstart: /getting-started/builder-quickstart
- API availability: /resources/api-coverage

## Core integration flows

- Accounts: /concepts/accounts
- Account registration: /builders/account-registration
- Wallet authorization: /funds/wallet-authorization
- Deposits: /funds/deposits
- Withdrawals: /funds/withdrawals
- PnL settlement: /funds/pnl-settlement
- Internal transfers: /funds/internal-transfers

## Builder operations

- Fee settings and order tags: /builders/configure-fees
- Builder information and revenue: /builders/revenue
- User data, campaigns, and referrals: /builders/user-data

## API specifications

- DexBuilder Trading API: /openapi/trading-v1.yaml
- Chinese Trading API: /openapi/zh/trading-v1.yaml

`◇` identifies a Builder interface that is not currently available on DexBuilder.
